program.name: Solanar Graduate Program
program.credential: Graduate Certificate of Completion in Tropical Meteorology & Hurricane Science
program.concentration: Tropical Cyclone Dynamics · Prediction · Hazards · Research
program.prerequisite: Solanar Professional Meteorology Certificate Years I–II or equivalent university-level meteorology preparation. Graduate Track 02 is recommended for students pursuing model/data-assimilation research.
program.credential_note: Internal Solanar/Khaemenes certificate of completion; not accredited university credit, government licensure, WMO designation, AMS certification, or a substitute for institutional degree requirements.

mathematics.name: Statistics

mathematics.name: Real & Complex Analysis

weeks.title: Tropical Atmosphere as a Distinct Dynamical Regime

days.label: Tropical Theory & Dynamics
days.work: Contrast tropical and extratropical dynamics: weak Coriolis near the equator, deep convection, moist static energy, weak temperature gradients aloft and large-scale overturning.

days.label: Mathematics & Quantitative Analysis
days.work: Calculate Coriolis parameter/inertial scales and review thermodynamic/energy budgets and nondimensional reasoning.

days.label: Observation / Case Laboratory
days.work: Map tropical latitude belts, ITCZ/monsoon regions and representative pressure/wind/moisture structures.

days.label: Forecast Guidance & Operations
days.work: Compare tropical analyses with midlatitude analyses and identify which familiar approximations weaken or change.

days.label: Research, Hazards & Defense
days.work: Establish graduate source/evidence notebook and defend why tropical forecasting requires a distinct conceptual model.
